case-pa.title: Case 4: the PA system

config.title: Case file: the community hall
config.story: During the club meeting, your SSB transmissions from the parking lot come out of the hall's PA speakers.
evidence: The PA system has no radio receiver in it.
Turning the PA volume up or down makes no difference.
The speaker cables are long runs around the hall.
config.caption: Muffled, distorted speech from the PA speakers, at the same level whatever the volume is set to.

case-pa.success: No RF circuits, volume makes no difference: audio rectification. Ferrite cores on the leads stop the RF getting in.

case-cw.title: Case 5: the CW version

config.title: Case file: the community hall, Morse edition
config.story: Now you're sending CW from the parking lot.
evidence: The PA system has no radio receiver in it.
The sound follows your keying exactly.
config.caption: An on-and-off humming in rhythm with your Morse.

case-cw.success: CW rectified in an audio system sounds like on-and-off humming. Ferrite on the leads again.

case-phone.title: Case 6: the telephone

config.title: Case file: the neighbour's phone
config.story: Your neighbour hears your voice on their landline telephone when you transmit.
evidence: Your station is operating properly and legally.
The telephone has no radio receiver.
config.caption: Your voice, distorted, mixed into the telephone call.

case-phone.success: Audio rectification in the phone. A modular plug-in RFI filter at the telephone cures it.

case-ocf.title: Case 7: the shack speaker

config.title: Case file: your own shack
config.story: You feed an off-centre-fed antenna with coax. When you transmit SSB, your outboard amplified speaker buzzes with distorted audio.
evidence: The antenna is unbalanced at the feed point.
RF can be felt on the coax shield inside the shack.
config.caption: Distorted audio and noise from the amplified speaker beside the radio whenever you transmit.

case-ocf.success: Current on the outside of the coax brings RF into the shack. A common-mode choke on the feedline stops it.
